final_message:
Configured DNS for all requested hostnames and the four mail domains. Every PC points to the recursive resolver at **pc18 (10.14.6.11)**.

The authoritative servers are pc1 for the artificial root, pc2 for `com`, pc3 for `net`, and pc10, pc14–pc17 for the requested domain zones. Their images and pc18’s were changed to `kathara/bind`; DNS files and startup lines were added without changing connections, addresses, or routes.

Startup scripts passed shell syntax checks. BIND validation tools were unavailable locally, and the lab was not started, so DNS resolution still needs an external runtime check. The MX records identify mail hosts; they do not configure mail-server software.
